breakdown.description: A small-angle approximation is used for a large wedge/turning angle where the approximation is not valid.
breakdown.reason: The core inconsistency was the use of a small-angle approximation for a large wedge angle where it is not valid. The ground truth corrected this by instructing to use the full theta-beta-Mach relation. The generated specification failed to fix this error and instead repeated the incorrect instruction from the original prompt, stating to 'Calculate the shock wave angle (beta) using the small-angle approximation formula beta ≈ mu + theta.'
